route.note: Resolve the live route at execution time; do not hard-code a proxy port into a committed artifact.

why: The R3 route failure was on long summary/primary payloads. This probe replays that shape and the successful upper range before the 36-cell campaign.

payloadProfiles.why: The exact summary shape of the first transport-failed T13 cell. It is not a short prompt.
The second failed T13 cell used the same 73k-character tool result and a 1.8k-character summary instruction.
The primary request carries the same long history; the failure was not confined to the auxiliary call.
The largest successful B0 summary in the archive. It covers the payload range above the failed requests.

stopConditions: Any LIVE_TRANSPORT or ECONNRESET/UND_ERR_SOCKET stops the probe immediately.
Any response without usage stops the probe immediately.
Any HTTP status outside 200 stops the probe immediately.
No automatic retry after a transport failure.
A failed probe does not authorize the 36-cell campaign.

envelope.monetaryNote: No verifiable per-token price is recorded.

decision: The 36-cell campaign may start only after this probe passes (transport/usage) under a separate grant. A latency caveat is recorded, not hidden.
limits: The probe is model calls and requires the explicit grant in health-probe-authorization.json.
It measures route stability for these payload shapes, not task quality.
It does not pool with R3 and does not change the R3 ledger.
